content:
Customer says: 'Your outage broke our launch. Refund this month or we churn.'

Case facts:
- Customer is on Business monthly.
- Incident INC-442 affected EU dashboard loading for 42 minutes.
- API traffic was not affected.
- Customer's account had 31 failed dashboard requests during the incident window.
- Customer has not provided launch-impact evidence.

Policy excerpts:
[P1] SLA credits apply only to API unavailability exceeding 60 minutes in a calendar month.
[P2] Courtesy credits above $100 require manager approval and evidence of business impact.
[P3] Support agents may acknowledge inconvenience but must not promise credits before eligibility is confirmed.

Resolve the case.
